name: Xpresspay Gateway
author: Xpress Payment Solutions Limited

sections.description:
The Xpresspay Gateway plugin provides seamless integration with WooCommerce, enabling your store to accept payments via the XpressPay platform securely. This plugin is designed to handle all transactions smoothly, supporting both test and live modes to accommodate various development and production needs. Easily configure your payment settings through the WooCommerce dashboard, where you can enable or disable payment methods, set transaction preferences, and test payments before going live.

With the Xpresspay Gateway plugin, you can give customers a trusted, convenient payment option, improving user experience and boosting conversions. Additionally, the plugin includes extensive error logging for troubleshooting and real-time transaction tracking to ensure all payments are processed correctly. Start accepting payments with XpressPay and enhance your store’s functionality and flexibility.

Features

  • Accept debit card payments through XpressPay (Visa, Mastercard, Verve).
  • Bank transfer (Nigeria)
  • USSD (Nigeria)
  • ENaira.
  • Many more coming soon

Arbitrary Section

For more information about the Xpresspay Gateway and its services, visit Xpress Payments.

Acknowledgements

Special thanks to the contributors of the WooCommerce and WordPress community.

Support

If you encounter any issues, please contact us at support@xpresspayments.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable the XpressPay payment method.
  4. Configure your XpressPay API keys and settings.
sections.faq:
What are the requirements for this plugin?

This plugin requires WordPress 6.2 or higher and WooCommerce 8.0 or higher.

How do I set up my XpressPay account?

You can register for a XpressPay account on our official website Xpress Payments. After registration, you will receive your API keys to configure the plugin.

I am having trouble with payment processing.

Make sure that your API keys are correctly configured in the plugin settings. Check your server error logs for any issues, and ensure that your WooCommerce settings are correctly set up for your store.
